option_relations.rationale: Option A describes a component of the full diagnosis in pred_1, specifically the morning glory disc anomaly and chronic retinal detachment.
Option B describes a component of the full diagnosis in pred_1, specifically the Morning Glory Syndrome and Cholesterolosis (which manifests as iridescent crystals).
Coats disease is a distinct retinal vascular disorder not directly related to the findings of morning glory disc anomaly, retinal detachment, or cholesterolosis.
Option D fully encompasses all key elements of the diagnosis described in pred_1, including synchysis scintillans (cholesterolosis), morning glory disc anomaly, and chronic retinal detachment.
